result.overallRead: This resume is extremely thin for a student candidate: contact and education are present, skills and some activities exist, but there are no projects or internships — the primary evidence a hiring reader expects. Fixing the missing evidence (projects/internships) and strengthening the activity bullets will materially improve interview chances.

dimensionNotes.note: Projects and any Internship/Experience section are missing; expected for a student and critical to demonstrate applied work.
Extracted text appears clean with no interleaved fragments, odd glyphs, or pseudo-tables.
Activities are written as noun phrases and weak statements rather than action-led bullets that start with verbs.
Resume is very short and unspecific; recent/most-relevant items (projects, internships) are absent so space allocation doesn't surface priorities.
No projects or internships listed — this is the single biggest gap for a student candidate.

findings.reason: A student resume needs at least one project or internship to show applied skills; without it a reader has nothing to evaluate beyond coursework.
No internships or relevant practical experience are listed; internships are the primary lever for early-career hiring decisions.
The extracted text looks parse-safe, but keep contact fields as plain text (no icons or inline links) to preserve ATS parsing.

findings.originalText: Java, Python, SQL (coursework level), HTML/CSS, Git, Linux basics
findings.suggestedText: Java, Python, SQL (coursework level), HTML/CSS, Git, Linux basics
findings.reason: Skills line is fine but will be more persuasive when paired with at least one project that exercises several of these skills.

projectSuggestions.title: College Event Registration System
projectSuggestions.scope: Build a web app to register participants for college events with attendee database, simple admin dashboard to view schedules and export CSVs, and a small authentication flow.
projectSuggestions.skillDemonstrated: HTML/CSS, Python (Flask/Django) or Java (Spring Boot), SQL, Git, Linux basics
projectSuggestions.groundedIn: OTHER SECTIONS: volunteered at the annual technical festival helping with event registration and scheduling

projectSuggestions.title: Hackathon Project: Team Collaboration Tool
projectSuggestions.scope: Create a lightweight collaboration tool for hackathon teams: task list, shared notes, and a simple real-time chat or activity feed; deploy to a free hosting tier.
projectSuggestions.skillDemonstrated: Java or Python backend, HTML/CSS frontend, Git, basic deployment on Linux
projectSuggestions.groundedIn: SKILLS: Java, Python, HTML/CSS, Git and OTHER SECTIONS: attended two intra-college hackathons

projectSuggestions.title: SQL-powered Dataset Explorer
projectSuggestions.scope: Publish a small data explorer that ingests an open dataset, creates an SQL schema, and offers filter/search interfaces and a sample analysis (e.g., summary stats, simple charts).
projectSuggestions.skillDemonstrated: SQL (coursework level), Python for ETL/analysis, HTML/CSS for UI, Git
projectSuggestions.groundedIn: EDUCATION: B.Tech in Computer Science and SKILLS: SQL (coursework level), Python

approach: Create one polished project (pick one from the projectSuggestions) and host code on GitHub with a README describing your role, architecture, and setup steps.
Use project README and hackathon participation as application evidence; in applications, link GitHub and a one-page project summary.
Apply to 15–30 internships with tailored 2-line intros mentioning your project and relevant coursework; prioritize roles that list required skills you have (Java/Python/SQL).
Network: message alumni or college seniors on LinkedIn who interned at target companies and ask for a 5–10 minute informational chat, mentioning your project as a discussion point.
internshipGuidance.leverageExisting: Use your coding club membership and hackathon attendance as talking points and evidence; include the event registration work (volunteer) as a transferable task to internships and as the basis for the suggested web app project.
